function.name: category_spending
function.description: How much the user actually spent in one budget category over a period (from imported bank statements); a budget row such as the car, fuel or rent counts as its category.

category.description: Category id, exactly one of: boende, mat, transport, prenumerationer, personligt, fritid, lan, sparande, givande. Never a row name.

period.description: Exactly one of: this_month, last_month, last_3_months, last_6_months, this_year, last_12_months.

function.name: list_subscriptions
function.description: Lists the user's recurring subscriptions (same amount every month) and their total per month and year.

function.name: daily_allowance
function.description: How much the user can spend per day and per week for the rest of the current month ("left to live on").

function.name: budget_kept
function.description: Whether the user kept to the budget in a given month, category by category (plan versus actual).

function.name: biggest_increases
function.description: Which spending categories have gone up the most lately, compared with earlier months.

function.name: where_money_went
function.description: The biggest purchases and the many small purchases in a month: where the money went, and what the user spends the most on.

function.name: search_purchases
function.description: Searches the user's imported purchases for a shop or place name (e.g. "ICA", "Amazon"), with the total spent there; not for a budget category or row.

query.description: The shop, place or word to look for, e.g. "ICA" or "gym".

period.description: Optional. Exactly one of: this_month, last_month, last_3_months, last_6_months, this_year, last_12_months. Default this_year.

function.name: goal_eta
function.description: When the user will reach one of their savings goals at the current pace.

goal.description: The name of the savings goal, as listed in the system message.

function.name: debt_overview
function.description: When the user will be debt-free and how much interest it costs, optionally with an extra amount paid each month.

extra_per_month.description: Optional. Extra amount paid towards debts each month, in the user's currency. Default 0.

strategy.description: Optional. Exactly one of: avalanche, snowball. Default avalanche (highest interest first); snowball only if the user asks for it (smallest debt first).

function.name: savings_projection
function.description: How the user's savings plan grows with compound interest over a number of years.

function.name: wallet_status
function.description: How much is left in one of the user's wallets (small separate budgets, e.g. for a trip).

wallet.description: The wallet's name, as listed in the system message.

function.name: what_if
function.description: Simulates a change to this month's budget without saving anything: the effect on what is left, per day and savings.

target.description: Exactly one of: income, boende, mat, transport, prenumerationer, personligt, fritid, lan, sparande, givande. income for salary or other income; otherwise the id of the category the changing row is listed under. Saving more, with no goal named, is sparande.

change.description: The change per month in the user's currency: positive for more (a rise), negative for less.

function.name: need_to_save
function.description: How much the user needs to save per month to reach an amount by a given month.

target_amount.description: The amount the user wants to have, in the user's currency.

by_month.description: The deadline as YYYY-MM, always after the current month: a month name means its next occurrence, which may be next year.

function.name: propose_set_amount
function.description: Proposes a new budgeted amount for one row (the user must approve it in the app before anything changes).

category.description: The row's category id, exactly one of: boende, mat, transport, prenumerationer, personligt, fritid, lan, sparande, givande. Never a row name.

row.description: The row's name as it appears in the budget, e.g. "Matvaror".

amount.description: The new monthly amount in the user's currency.

function.name: propose_add_row
function.description: Proposes adding a new budget row (the user must approve it before anything changes).

category.description: Category id, exactly one of: boende, mat, transport, prenumerationer, personligt, fritid, lan, sparande, givande. Never a row name. Pick the one that fits the new row best.

amount.description: Its monthly amount in the user's currency.

function.name: propose_create_goal
function.description: Proposes creating a savings goal (the user must approve it before anything changes).

target_amount.description: The amount to save, in the user's currency.

by_month.description: The deadline as YYYY-MM, always after the current month: a month name means its next occurrence, which may be next year.

function.name: propose_debt_plan
function.description: Proposes setting the extra monthly debt payment and the strategy (the user must approve it).

extra_per_month.description: Extra amount per month towards debts.

strategy.description: Exactly one of: avalanche, snowball. Default avalanche (highest interest first); snowball only if the user asks for it (smallest debt first).

function.name: propose_recategorize
function.description: Proposes moving all purchases from one shop, service or place (e.g. "Spotify", "ICA") to another category; no budget row changes (the user must approve it).

place.description: The shop or place name as it appears on the bank statement, e.g. "ICA".

category.description: The category id, exactly one of: boende, mat, transport, prenumerationer, personligt, fritid, lan, sparande, givande. Never a row name.
